"Ngibuyele khona kwamasipala ngifuna ukuyoqhubeka nezinhlelo zami zokudayisela indodakazi umuzi ngatshelwa into efanayo - ukuthi kangikwazi ukuwudayisa ngoba isikweletu kangikasikhokhi futhi siyakhula," kusho yena.
Uthi ishintshile inkulumo watshelwa ukuthi isikweletu ngesendawo okwakhiwe kuyona indlu yakhe kwazise yinkulu kakhulu.

Ukuqhwagwa KwamaHholo OMbuso Kubonisa Inzondo Ngenkolo

Lesi sikhulu siveze nokuthi basaba ukuthi neligi ye-outdoor, okumele iqale ngo-Ephreli iphele ngoSepthemba ngeke iqale ngesikhathi ngenxa yeCoronavirus.
